self_correction_during_make: First AC4/recursion test runs used POSIX-style scratch paths (/c/Users/...) as the synthetic cwd. Native Windows Node.js does not resolve those the way it resolves drive-letter paths (T:/...), so fs.readdirSync threw internally and the script's catch-and-fail-open-to-deny path produced the *expected* deny result for the wrong reason — not genuine no-open-trail detection. Caught by noticing the recursion test (which should have passed) instead failed, re-ran both with proper T:/ drive-letter paths, got correct results.
